fields.Name: ORD-37 - Contract Reversal
fields.Description: Reversing a scheduled order (golive #240, D92 section 6). A company billed by instalment never posts a value entry at confirm, so a reversal cannot mirror one: instalments nobody was billed for are withdrawn with no entry, what was billed and not yet earned is credited back as a credit memo debiting Deferred Revenue and crediting Accounts Receivable, and a line that earned more than it billed refuses the reversal rather than stranding a contract asset in Unbilled Receivable. Revenue already recognised stays recognised.

ExpectedOutcomes.summary: A deferred line whose first instalment was issued at confirm reverses to a two-line credit memo for exactly the billed-and-unearned balance, the entry naming the order and line it unwinds, with the unissued instalment cancelled and the invoiced one left untouched and still numbered; an order with no schedule reverses with no credit memo at all and credits the receivable for the whole line as it always did; an up-front line on a scheduled company, which earns in full at confirm while only the due instalment is billed, refuses the reversal with a message naming the unbilled amount, and nothing on the schedule moves.
